## Change

Describe what changed and why. Link the issue with `Closes #...`.

## Checks

- [ ] Run `pnpm verify:fast` and the relevant integration tests; list results or explain skipped checks below.
- [ ] Add or update intent for changes under `apps/`, `packages/`, `cli/`, `scripts/`, or `db/`, or mark this not applicable.
- [ ] Add an ADR for core contract or migration changes, or mark this not applicable. Keep migrations append-only.
- [ ] Run `pnpm intent:index` after intent changes and commit any updated index, or mark this not applicable.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ayaangazali/eyes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the commands and requirements.
